svg.title: TD-VLA: queries, architecture and attention masks

g.text: Parallel action, track and stage prediction
One forward pass · three parallel outputs
Fully bidirectional · Q / K / V from query features
Q: updated query features · K / V: conditioning tokens
Block ↔ Full: same queries, heads and supervision;
All queries read the same current conditioning tokens through cross-attention.
Masks use representative positions, not true token proportions. Only BERT is frozen; all other modules are jointly trained.
